items.stem: The workflow proposes to auto-send follow-up emails generated by ChatGPT. What is the safest design?

options.text: Draft the email and require human approval before sending
options.rationale: Correct: outbound communication is a high-impact action that warrants a human gate.

options.text: Send automatically and apologise for mistakes later
options.rationale: Sending first and correcting later damages trust and may breach policy.

options.text: Send only to internal addresses automatically
options.rationale: Internal recipients can still be harmed by an incorrect or premature message.

options.text: Send if the draft is under 100 words
options.rationale: Length is unrelated to whether the content is correct or appropriate.

items.explanation: Correct: outbound communication is a high-impact action that warrants a human gate.

items.stem: Which TWO practices keep AI summaries trustworthy in this workflow? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Cite each claim back to its source
options.rationale: Correct: traceable claims can be checked.

options.text: Verify summaries against the source text
options.rationale: Correct: checking against the source catches overstatement.

options.text: Share research docs as 'anyone with the link'
options.rationale: Open link sharing is a governance risk, not a trust practice.

options.text: Paste summaries as free text into Sheets

items.explanation: Correct: traceable claims can be checked.
